3453.title: Successful ACP writes return null
3453.rootCauseOneLine: The successful filesystem write handler supplies null to the JSON-RPC responder.
3453.proposedFix: Verify the upstream contract, then return an object and add a strict response regression test.
3453.caveats: Handler-level reproduction only; upstream schema and live Devin behavior unverified. Normal build blocked by local pnpm launcher.
